'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Brandon Brist LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Brist]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Combat
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
